# French Properly

> French Properly (https://frenchproperly.com) is a modern, structured French learning platform offering a comprehensive written curriculum organized across CEFR levels A1 through C2.

## Overview

French Properly provides clear, grammar-first explanations, vocabulary tables, culture notes, and interactive practice exercises designed to take learners from total beginner to complete mastery.

## Curriculum & Levels

- **A1: Beginner** — Foundational greetings, pronunciation, articles, present tense verbs, and everyday essentials. (100% Free)
- **A2: Elementary** — Past tense (*passé composé*, *imparfait*), routine communication, directions, and familiar settings. (100% Free)
- **B1: Intermediate** — Expressing opinions, storytelling, subjunctive mood, and independent conversational navigation.
- **B2: Upper Intermediate** — Argumentation, formal registers, media comprehension, and nuanced discourse.
- **C1: Advanced** — Stylistic precision, complex syntax, idioms, and advanced professional and literary registers.
- **C2: Mastery** — Near-native idiomatic command, subtle subtext, rhetoric, and cultural mastery.

## Free vs. Lifetime Access

- **80+ Free Lessons:** All A1 and A2 written lessons (over 100 comprehensive lessons with vocabulary and interactive exercises) are completely free to read and practice without creating an account or paying.
- **B1–C2 Lifetime Access:** Access to the intermediate and advanced levels (B1 through C2) requires a simple one-time payment.
  - **Price:** A founding price for early learners, then the standard price; see https://frenchproperly.com/pricing
  - **Included:** All current B1–C2 written lessons plus all future written lessons and curriculum updates included. No recurring subscriptions or monthly fees.
